description: Publish a new entry to the project's Fizlog changelog (in-app widget, public page and RSS). Use it after shipping a feature or fix. Write for end users, not developers: a short benefit-focused title and 1–3 sentences of Markdown (**bold**, *italic*, `code`, [links](url), '- ' lists). Set draft=true to save without publishing, or published_at to schedule.

draft.description: Save as an unpublished draft instead of publishing.

notify_subscribers.description: Also email the project's subscribers (only for immediate, non-draft entries).

published_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time. A future value schedules the entry.

title.description: Short, user-facing headline, e.g. 'Dark mode is here'.

type.description: new = feature, improved = enhancement, fixed = bug fix.

name: publish_entry
title: Publish changelog entry
